text:
zoe (new-hire): hey team — quick q about my first PR: what's the expected size, branching name, and review flow? Also any style guides I should follow? 🙏

matt: welcome! Short answers: keep PRs < 400 LOC where possible. Branch: feature/ONB-<ticket>-short-desc (e.g., feature/ONB-42-setup-env). Reviews: 1 reviewer + package owner. If touching runtime/infra, add @anna and @ravi. Default merge strategy: squash and merge. :+1:

anna: CI checklist: run unit tests and the integration smoke locally. CI will block on lint/test failures. We enforce pre-commit hooks — run `pre-commit install` (repo has .pre-commit-config.yaml).

devex-bot: PR template available in repo root: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md — includes Summary, Test Plan, Rollout/Backup plan, and Migration notes.

ravi: If PR touches serving/runtime, include a short perf checklist and any eval snippets you used. Tag PR with `perf-risk` if it could impact p50/p99 > ~10%.

julia: Style guides: Python -> black + ruff, JS/TS -> prettier + eslint (configs under /tools/standard). Commit message format we prefer: `<scope>: short summary` (e.g., runtime: fix cache invalidation). Add `Closes #<ticket>` when appropriate.

matt: A few practical tips: 1) Keep PRs focused — split refactors into a follow-up. 2) Use draft PRs if you want early feedback. 3) If you're unsure who should review, ping me or check CODEOWNERS. Don't merge if CI is red.

zoe (new-hire): thanks — where's the PR template link and who merges if I'm blocked?

devex-bot: Template: https://git.redwood.ai/platform/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and it's also in the repo root. For merge approvals, contact matt or julia; on-call reviewers are listed in CODEOWNERS.

anna: one more ops note — if you change container images update images/README.md and bump tags in infra/helm values. Add a rollout note in the PR describing safe rollback steps.

zoe (new-hire): great, i'll start with a tiny docs PR to get the flow. thanks everyone :tada:

matt: welcome again — shout if you get stuck, i'll review your first PR.
